roxy.fog.automatic.tooltip: Bring fog into nearby terrain during rain and thunderstorms, following Minecraft's weather fade.
roxy.fog.start.tooltip: Clear-weather distance in chunks where fog begins, with voxy's current render distance as the endpoint.
roxy.fog.weather_roll_in.tooltip: How strongly weather brings fog into nearby terrain. The higher the value the closer fog rolls in.
roxy.fog.requires_mod: Requires a supported fog mod: Fog or No Man's Land.
